cited.quote: Purpose for which loan can be obtained - Maternity Loan through Self help groups

rationale: C1 and C2 are cooperative-bank maternity loan scheme pages that only route loans through existing self-help groups. No extract shows creation of new self-help groups, training for them, or a dedicated loan scheme. C4 and C5 are unrelated. No official step for the commitment.

rationale: C2 is a GO (2016-08-29) ordering implementation of a rural roads improvement scheme for 2016-17, and C4 (2016-09-23) sanctions construction of 51 bridges. These cover roads and bridges. C1 and C3 are only budget and Governor statements. No extract shows an order for bypasses or road over bridges, so only part is shown.

cited.quote: had been designed to promote entrepreneurship amongst first generation entrepreneurs

rationale: C1, a budget speech, describes the NEEDS scheme for first-generation entrepreneurs and says money is allocated. That is a budget statement, not a GO or launch. C2 to C5 are agriculture items for other beneficiaries. No official step shown.

cited.quote: Early Intervention Centre for children with Autism in Siragugal Special School
Early Intervention Centres for children with Mental Retardation in 31 Districts

rationale: C5 is a GO dated 2016-06-09, after the government took office, sanctioning a grant for an early intervention centre for children with autism. C2 (2016-09-27) is a GO continuing early intervention centres in 31 districts with sanction. These are orders for differently abled persons' opportunities. They are mostly continuations, so the match is loose.

cited.quote: accord permission for continuance of the State Resource cum Training Centre at Trichy for the year 2016-17

rationale: The GOs in C3, C4 and C5 only continue existing centres for 2016-17, and the scheme pages C1 and C2 show schemes introduced in 2012. No extract shows a new scheme launched to ensure full participation of differently abled persons.

cited.quote: administrative approval for implementation of the Coconut Development Board assisted scheme in Tamil Nadu

rationale: The coconut GOs (C1 to C5) approve Coconut Development Board assisted schemes at a total outlay of Rs.187.50 lakh, with nurseries and demonstration plots. That is a far smaller, different scheme from a Rs.800 crore special scheme to cut and replant old coconut trees. No such step shown.

None of the extracts mentions Illandhorum Inaiyam or a home internet or e-service of that kind. C1 and C3 concern land records and online patta transfer, a different service. C2, C4 and C5 are agriculture and health insurance items.

cited.quote: this Government will take up flood 30 prevention works like widening the drainage
